team_style_pace_mismatch_on_production.classification_evidence: Close-graded look; per AGENTS.md's binding grade rule a close-graded run settles no play/no-play decision regardless of sign, so a terminal classification is reserved for the opener grade. The week-blocked interval [-0.400, +4.667] does not sit entirely on either side of zero, so no closing ground is admissible; probability_positive 0.944 favours the candidate on EV.
team_style_pace_mismatch_on_production.description: Team-style pace-mismatch flag (1 when |home-away prior-season league-centred seconds_per_play_pace| is at or above an EXPANDING top-quartile threshold estimated from strictly prior seasons only) as one extra feature column on top of PRODUCTION weak_stack / market_residual / ridge alpha 10.0, vs the identical production chain without it. Paired candidate-minus-baseline forced-pick accuracy delta, close-graded, rotation-assigned window [2011, 2013].
team_style_pace_mismatch_on_production.notes: Window [2011, 2013] ASSIGNED by nfl-ats rotation assign, never hand-picked; --mode screen after both instrument checks passed. Positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin): +50.134 accuracy points, week-blocked P+ 1.000, 95% [+46.428, +53.652], 100.0th percentile of its own null -- the full-profile ridge fit is NOT blind. Within-week permutation null (200 draws, real features): centre -0.259 pts, sd 1.162, 95% [-2.416, +1.749]; the observed +2.011 sits at the 97.5th percentile of that null. Home-pick rates: baseline 53.646%, candidate 53.776% -- 0.13 points apart, so this measurement carries essentially none of the home-tilt artifact that discounted the bare-baseline screens. Flag coverage inside the window is 100.000% of 768 REG games, firing on 23.698% (182 games), reproducing the registered screen's 23.6% firing rate. Season-blocked secondary 95% [-2.000, +6.531], P+ 0.857 -- reported beside the week-blocked primary, never averaged with it, and read with caution because 3 season blocks give the season bootstrap very little combinatorial diversity. DECLARED DEVIATION (docs/team_style_pace_on_production.md section 2.1): the registered bare-baseline cell team_style_pace_mismatch_dog_cover cuts its top quartile over the WHOLE 2009-2025 panel, a mild look-ahead; this column recomputes the cut EXPANDING over strictly prior seasons only, making it a slightly different quantity whose noisier threshold can only attenuate toward the null. NOT POOLABLE with the bare-baseline team-style battery: that battery scored a subset cover-rate gap against a bare market baseline scaled to the full slate, this scores a paired accuracy delta against the full production ridge chain -- non-commensurable comparators under AGENTS.md's commensurability rule, and not even the same column.
team_style_pace_mismatch_on_production.plain_summary: When two teams play at very different tempos, adding that mismatch to the model made it pick more winners than the model we actually use.
